question: The sides AB, BC, CD and DA of a quadrilateral ABCD touch a circle at P, Q, R and S, respectively. If AB = 16 cm, DS = 10 cm RC = 3 cm, then find the perimeter of the quadrilateral ABCD (in cm).
solution:
**Given:**

AB = 16 cm.

RC = 3 cm 

DS = 10 cm 

**Formula used:**

The perimeter of a quadrilateral = (Sum of all the sides)

**Concept used:**

Tangent to a point from a circle are equal then AS = AP and BP = BQ

**Calculations:**

According to the question,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2011fb5492a5059e71c169754bc82252e39354c3b1bc583c65be0df678f649ab.png] 

⇒ AB = AP + BP,

AS = BQ then, AS + BQ = 16 ( 8 + 8)

⇒ RC = CQ then, RC = 3 & CQ = 3

⇒ DS = RD then, DS = 10 & RD = 10 

∴ Perimeter of the quadrilateral

⇒ AB + ( AS + BQ ) + QC + RC + RD + DS 

⇒ 16 + 16 + 3 + 3 + 10 + 10 = 58.

**∴ The perimeter of the quadrilateral is 58 cm.**
